data.one_liner: Format currencies with custom symbols and separators without locale ties.
data.what_it_does: MoneyFormatter provides a way to format double values into various currency formats, compact forms, and string representations using customizable separators and symbols. It also includes built-in comparison tools and fast arithmetic calculation methods.
use_when: You need to format currency numbers without relying on standard device or app localization.
You need custom thousands and decimal separators alongside configurable currency symbols.
You want to perform simple arithmetic calculations chained directly onto formatting instances.
avoid_when: You require full device localization and locale-aware number formatting.
You need advanced multi-currency conversion rates fetched from an API.
strengths: Supports fast mathematical calculations and instance chaining.
Provides both normal and compact output formats.
weaknesses: Does not automatically fetch or handle locale-specific currency rules natively.
Limited to basic math operations and simple formatting outputs.

alternatives.name: intl
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick intl if you need standard localization and locale-aware number and currency formatting.

alternatives.name: decimal
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick decimal if you need precise decimal arithmetic without floating-point inaccuracies for financial calculations.
